capabilities: : Stores relationship content in bond notes
: Renders bond content on both connected notes
: Allows bonds to hold content and types
disambiguation: Not a general note-linking tool; it specifically transforms standard links into content-carrying notes (bonds).
intentEvidence: A bond is a real note: it can hold content, carry a type, appear in search, and grow over time
motivation: The author argues that all knowledge is relative and that the connections between ideas are the most valuable part of knowledge, which current tools fail to capture.
problem: Standard links in note-taking apps are bare pointers lacking content or identity, meaning relationship information cannot be stored where it belongs.
summary: Bonds transforms standard links into first-class notes (bonds) that carry their own content and display it automatically on both connected notes.
